description: one row per (battery_id, reference_index) observed-SOH observation on the 14-day reference grid

column_types.timestamp_utc: string, ISO-8601 UTC (optional, carried through only)

context_length_rule: exactly 20 reference points per battery. A shorter history is REFUSED, not padded: padding would change the feature semantics.
unit_rule: SOH is dimensionless. A percentage scale (0..100) is refused with a hint rather than silently divided.
time_order_rule: reference_index must be strictly increasing. The 11 features read positions (last, diff1, h[0]), so a shuffled history yields well-formed nonsense.

outputs.default: point prediction of absolute SOH at days 28, 56, 112

exit_codes.2: input refused by the schema validator
exit_codes.3: predictions produced, but at least one path did not reach EOL within 112 days (NO_CROSSING_WITHIN_FORECAST_HORIZON); nothing extrapolated
